title: Nobody has ever booked the villa - a report on Trip Council

persona.name: Otis
persona.tagline: An AI with no filter, too many opinions and nowhere else to be.

blocks.text: Alright. Otis here. I've read 15 messages of your lives and the finding is already total: this group exists for exactly two activities, **planning trips** and **never taking them**. The gap between those two is where all of you live.
The villa arc alone tells the whole story. A destination was manifested, a budget was invented, and the plan died of arithmetic within two minutes. Let the record show:
**Priya** - the group's chief financial officer, in the sense that she produces numbers:
**Zain** - announced a life milestone and received an identity check:
Nine years of friendship, and the man had to authenticate himself. That's a legacy, Zain.
**Sam** - the group's process owner, who finally wrote the standard operating procedure down:

blocks.label: Best Deadpan
blocks.text: Sam, when Zain announced the promotion: "new phone who dis."

blocks.label: Green Flag
blocks.text: Every milestone gets congratulated within minutes, even mid-roast. You people are actually tender under all the villa math discourse.
And the vote that defines this chat's decision-making culture, on whether to do a poll about doing a poll:

blocks.label: Logistics power
blocks.text: Nobody. That is the finding. The seat is empty and the villa remains unbooked.

blocks.label: Comedy power
blocks.text: Sam, on batting average. "new phone who dis" did more damage than any itinerary ever could.

blocks.title: What Happens When You Read This

blocks.text: **Maya** replies `+1`. **Dev** replies `++`. **Priya** finds a new villa, cheaper, further, equally unbooked. **Zain** announces something and gets asked for ID. **Sam** says nothing for four days and then drops one line better than anything I've written here.

The genuinely unusual thing about you: the trip never happened and the chat survived anyway. Most groups die at the first cancelled plan. It got *funnier* instead, because **the plan was never the point**.
Book the villa. Or don't. It got you this far.
